description: Add durable on_error policies that use the configured coding provider to repair approved gate failures in the same workspace, retry the failed gate within a strict attempt limit, and record repair evidence.

comments.text: Implemented on_error as a self-retry policy for ValidateScope and Verify only. Limits are 1-3 attempts. Repair intent, prompt, provider result, and errors are durable. Repository-state and unknown failures stay terminal. The llmux local workflow uses Grok with one attempt for scope and verification.

title: Add bounded workflow repair loops
